description: This classic Fresh Squeezed Lemonade is the quintessential American summer drink, bursting with vibrant citrus flavor and perfectly balanced sweetness. Its refreshing tang makes it an ideal thirst-quencher for any occasion, from backyard barbecues to lazy afternoons on the porch. Simple to make yet incredibly satisfying, this homemade lemonade recipe will quickly become a family favorite.

instructions.title: Prepare the Simple Syrup
instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine 1 cup of granulated sugar with 1 cup of water. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar is completely dissolved. Do not boil. Remove from heat and let the simple syrup cool completely to room temperature. This ensures a smooth, sweet base for your lemonade.

instructions.title: Squeeze the Lemons
instructions.text: While the simple syrup cools, thoroughly wash and then halve your lemons. Using a citrus juicer or reamer, extract as much juice as possible from the lemons. Strain the fresh lemon juice through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any pulp or seeds, aiming for about 1.5 cups of pure lemon juice.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: In a large pitcher, combine the cooled simple syrup, the freshly squeezed and strained lemon juice, and the remaining 3 cups of cold water. Stir the mixture well with a long spoon to ensure all ingredients are fully incorporated.

instructions.title: Taste and Adjust Sweetness
instructions.text: Pour a small amount of the lemonade into a glass and taste it. Depending on the tartness of your lemons and your personal preference, you may want to add more simple syrup for sweetness or a splash more water to dilute it slightly. Adjust gradually until it reaches your desired balance.

instructions.title: Chill Thoroughly
instructions.text: Once you are satisfied with the flavor, cover the pitcher and refrigerate the lemonade for at least 30 minutes. Chilling allows the flavors to meld together beautifully and ensures a truly refreshing drink. The colder it is, the better it tastes.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: When ready to serve, fill tall glasses with plenty of ice. Pour the chilled fresh squeezed lemonade over the ice. Garnish each glass with a fresh lemon slice and a sprig of mint, if desired, for an extra touch of aroma and visual appeal. Enjoy immediately!

tips: For an authentic American touch, use a wooden spoon to stir your simple syrup, ensuring thorough dissolution without scorching the sugar.
If you dont have enough fresh lemons, you can substitute a small portion with good quality bottled lemon juice in a pinch, though fresh is always best for flavor.
Store leftover lemonade in a sealed pitcher in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days. Stir well before serving as ingredients may settle.
